correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the common seed gives a deterministic image of size at most M. Exact support on each of finitely many input rows forces this image to meet every allowed output row for almost every seed simultaneously. Two outputs y,z cannot suffice: choose x=(y_1,z_2), which excludes them both; the written Hamming-distance intersection count additionally gives the sharp maximum two-output cover q^2-2. Three distinct diagonal symbols give a support cover when q>=3, and independent coordinate permutations followed by the equivariant tie-break give invariant probabilities over the whole allowed row, because the stabilizer of that input acts transitively there. For q=2 the target is a deterministic bijection, so almost every seed (not literally every seed on an arbitrary null set) needs all four outputs; four messages work. An independently written exact check, /workspace/review_evidence/5_exact_counts.py, verifies the maximum two-output cover for q=2..6, the binary bijection, and integer-weight uniformity of the proposed simulator for all input rows at q=3,4 and two representative rows at q=5,6. The group argument, not those finite checks, establishes exactness for all q.

evidence: Cubitt et al. state the exact convex hull of deterministic channels with image size at most k and use support covering plus permutation covariance for uniform-on-subset channels U_(n,m), including the one-use W_q as U_(q,q-1) after relabelling inputs. Kazemi's inspected Proposition 7 is for the upper invariant on K_n × K_2, not the minimum on every square.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Prop. 19 is not a direct closed formula for tensor squares, whose input supports are a restricted family of subsets. Its proof technique and characterization apply directly once the support cover is specified. The 2012 minimum k-tuple source was not used as evidence for its inaccessible exact hypotheses.

evidence: Choose a deterministic function supported by a minimum cover, then conjugate it by a uniform independent permutation of each coordinate. The law remains supported, has the same cost, and is uniform on the allowed row because the row stabilizer is transitive. The exact indexed minima are 3 and 4. Even without quoting those minima, two points always lie in one mixed row-column cross and three points in distinct rows and columns never do.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The prior exact simulation method and supported-map average, followed by the already-covered graph invariant, yields the full claimed result. The published ternary example is second-order channel interconversion and is not the proof of this exact cost. The construction does not introduce a new convex-hull facet, obstruction, or regime requiring different simulation reasoning.

evidence: Allowed pairs are exactly edges of K_q × K_q (categorical product). Meeting each input's allowed row is equivalent to open-neighborhood total domination. Exact support plus the S_q × S_q covariance determines the uniform probability row.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A graph optimum without the symmetry reduction would not alone prove simulation. Given Theorem 15 and the covariant construction of Proposition 19, averaging a deterministic supported map with image in a minimum graph cover gives exactly the desired distribution and preserves its message bound. This proves equality of the two optima, not just a numerical resemblance.

originality.rationale: The exact numbers are a mechanical specialization of the known shared-randomness simulation support/covariance method to a graph minimum already covered by distinct indexed work. No claim about publication order between same-day records is made; earlier primary work identifies the exact off-diagonal NOT channel and uses the same support and twirling argument for it, and the graph computation adds only the elementary row-column obstruction and three-cell matching.
residual_risks: Lawful primary full text for the 2012 graph paper was unavailable and the same-day catalogue records cannot establish chronology. Neither limit is used as negative originality evidence; mathematical coverage is established by the actual support and symmetry implication.
